questions.source_raw:
Using the five-step problem-solving strategy, solve the following problem: 
An object starts with an initial velocity of 3.8m/s and moves along a straight line with a 
constant acceleration of −1.1m/s2. What is the displacement of the object when its 
velocity is −5.2m/s?
questions.stem: An object starts with an initial velocity of 3.8m/s and moves along a straight line with a constant acceleration of $-1.1 \, \text{m/s}^2$. What is the displacement of the object when its velocity is $-5.2 \, \text{m/s}$?
